in_arabic.name: زيناب

in_urdu.name: زیناب
in_urdu.long_meaning: زیناب نام کا مطلب خوبصورت، حسین، یا اللہ کی زینت ہے، یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اسلامی تقویم میں اہم تاریخی واقعات سے منسلک ہے، خاص طور پر نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کی بیٹیوں میں سے ایک کا نام

data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Zainab is considered a significant figure, known for her remarkable courage and dedication to her faith. One famous Zainab is Lady Zainab, the sister of Imam Hussein, a central figure in Shia Islam. Her unwavering faith and loyalty during the Battle of Kerbala in the face of scarcity, oppression, and adversity continue to inspire millions to this day. Zainab represents resilience, determination, and strong faith in the face of adversity. Her name embodies the spiritual significance of perseverance and the power of one's unwavering commitment to their beliefs in the face of great challenges.
